items.text: Saquon Barkley (PHI) is active vs DAL tonight after two missed games with the hamstring; Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are on IR, so Dameon Pierce is the only other healthy back. RB12 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share tonight vs DAL.
items.watch: his snap share tonight vs DAL

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (SF) has a mild hamstring strain from the loss at ATL, and Kyle Shanahan is pretty optimistic he is fine after the Week 8 bye; he came back and played 34 snaps. RB6 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a missed practice after the bye would change that.
items.why: Mild strain and a bye week; only a missed practice after the bye would change the call.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (BAL) missed a third straight game with the high ankle sprain, and Jesse Minter expects him to be in a decent spot for Week 8, with more known Wednesday. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.

Rashid Shaheed (SEA) left the win over KC with a knee injury, and Mike Macdonald said the early test results are positive. He caught 5 for 66 on 8 targets at DEN in Week 6. WR60 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's Wednesday practice report.

Jadarian Price (SEA) has his IR practice window opening this week, per Mike Macdonald; he has been out with the chest injury since Oct. 3. RB37 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Bryce Young (CAR) was pulled for Kenny Pickett down 43-6 to TB, then was listed as a full participant with the knee on Monday's estimated report for Thursday at GB. QB12 rest of season for me. Monitor Dave Canales' starter word before Thursday.
items.watch: Dave Canales' starter word before Thursday at GB

items.text: Jalen Coker (CAR) was limited with the shoulder on Monday's estimated report for Thursday at GB. WR33 rest of season for me. Monitor Carolina's Wednesday injury report.

Matthew Golden (GB) did not take part in Monday's walkthrough with shoulder and foot injuries, a day after 12 targets and 165 air yards at DET. WR25 rest of season for me. Monitor Green Bay's Tuesday practice report before Thursday vs CAR.

Klint Kubiak said Kirk Cousins (LV) stays the starter for Week 8 against the Jets after a fourth straight loss, and that No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza is expected to play at some point. Mendoza is QB33 rest of season for me. Monitor Kubiak's starter call after Week 8.
items.watch: Klint Kubiak's starter call after Week 8

items.text: Sean McVay did not know Monday whether the Rams open Terrance Ferguson's (LAR) IR practice window this week. TE22 rest of season for me. Monitor whether the Rams open his window before you spend a bench spot.
items.watch: whether the Rams open his practice window this week

items.text: Aaron Jones Sr. (MIN) is day-to-day with the knee, and Adam Schefter reported it is not considered significant; Monday's MRI decides Week 8 at DET. He played 15 snaps behind Jordan Mason before he left, so Mason is the lead back either way. RB27 rest of season for me. Monitor Minnesota's Wednesday practice report.

items.why: A setback in practice before Week 9 vs PHI would change the call.
items.text: Cam Skattebo (NYG) avoided a hamstring strain, per Dan Duggan, after 17 carries for 124 yards and a TD at HOU, and the Giants are on bye in Week 8. RB23 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a setback in practice before Week 9 vs PHI would change that.

Zach Charbonnet (SEA) is inactive vs KC tonight, as Seattle said Friday, so the knee gets one more week. Emanuel Wilson (SEA) played 46 snaps in Week 6 and leads the backfield; he is RB30 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play. Charbonnet is RB40 rest of season for me. Pivot to Emanuel Wilson.

Rashee Rice (KC) is inactive at SEA tonight with the hamstring and knee after a week without practice. Xavier Worthy (KC) is the top outside receiver left and is WR30 for me, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play. Rice is WR21 rest of season for me. Pivot to Xavier Worthy.

Jordan Mason (MIN) led the Vikings with 15 carries for 68 yards in his first game off IR, and Aaron Jones Sr. left with the knee. RB33 rest of season for me, and the lead back at DET if Jones sits. Claim him if he is on your wire, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

items.watch: Houston's first practice report after the Week 8 bye
items.text: Jaylin Noel (HOU) hurt his toe in the overtime loss to NYG; DeMeco Ryans called it turf toe and gave no timeline. Tank Dell is the next slot receiver up. Noel is WR63 rest of season for me. Monitor Houston's first practice report after the Week 8 bye.
Puka Nacua (LAR) played through the calf at LV and caught an 11-yard touchdown, one of Matthew Stafford's three first-half TD passes. WR3 rest of season for me.

CJ Donaldson (NO) was ruled out of the loss to PIT in Paris with a shoulder injury. Kendre Miller had 20 carries as the lead back in Week 6 and is RB64 rest of season for me. Monitor Donaldson on New Orleans' Wednesday practice report before you count on him for the goal line.

items.watch: his snap share Sunday at TEN
items.text: Cleveland activated Dylan Sampson (CLE) off IR Saturday after the knee injury from the opener at JAX. He caught 33 passes in 16 career games, and Quinshon Judkins has no designation at RB40 for me. Sampson is RB56 rest of season. Monitor his snap share Sunday at TEN.
Makai Lemon (PHI) starts Monday vs DAL with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both out. He caught 3 for 19 on 6 targets in Week 6. WR49 for me, a dart throw, and WR47 rest of season.

Philadelphia ruled DeVonta Smith (PHI) out for Monday vs DAL after he missed all three practices with the hamstring. Dontayvion Wicks (PHI) is out with the ankle too, so rookie Makai Lemon starts. Smith is WR15 rest of season for me; this week, pivot to Germie Bernard, WR21 for me at NO, a WR2.

Dallas Goedert (PHI) practiced in full Saturday after missing Thursday and Friday with the knee, and he has no designation for Monday. He caught 6 for 61 in Tanner McKee's first start. TE9 for me this week vs DAL.

items.watch: Eagles inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday
items.text: Saquon Barkley (PHI) practiced in full Saturday after two limited days with the hamstring, and he is questionable for Monday vs DAL. RB29 for me this week, a high-end RB3, and RB12 rest of season. Monitor the Eagles' inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday.

Minnesota activated Jordan Mason (MIN) off IR Saturday, and he plays vs IND with no designation after full practices all week. He takes the early downs from Aaron Jones Sr., who stays RB18 for me, a low-end RB2. Mason is RB28 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Baltimore ruled Lamar Jackson (BAL) out vs CIN Saturday with the high ankle sprain, his third straight missed game, and Tyler Huntley starts again. Lamar stays QB2 rest of season for me. This week, pivot to Bo Nix, QB15 for me at ARI, a streamer.

Denver activated Jonah Coleman (DEN) off IR Saturday after full practices all week, and he plays at ARI. He cuts into J.K. Dobbins' early downs; Dobbins is RB23 for me this week, an RB2. Coleman is RB49 rest of season. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB, and hold him where he is rostered.
Green Bay added Josh Jacobs (GB) to the active roster Saturday, so he debuts at DET after his week back from the exempt list. RB17 for me this week, an RB2, and RB22 rest of season.
George Pickens (DAL) moved up to a full practice Friday with the shoulder after a limited Thursday, so he is on track for Monday night at PHI. WR17 for me this week, a WR2, and WR12 rest of season.

Brian Robinson Jr. (ATL) is out vs SF with the hamstring after missing practice Wednesday and Thursday, so Bijan Robinson (ATL) has no veteran sharing the backfield Sunday. Bijan Robinson is RB2 for me this week after only 9 carries vs CHI; Robinson Jr. comes off benches.
Germie Bernard (PIT) ran a route on every dropback and drew 12 targets in Week 6, with Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on IR. WR21 for me vs NO in Paris this week, a WR2.

Mike Washington Jr. (LV) took half the early downs in Week 6, a season-high 35 percent of the snaps, while Ashton Jeanty fell to 58 percent. RB39 for me vs LAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, and RB48 rest of season. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Ja'Kobi Lane (BAL) ran a route on 58 percent of the dropbacks and drew 5 targets in his first game off IR. WR46 for me vs CIN, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
Cole Kmet's likely season-ending knee injury leaves the Chicago tight end routes to Colston Loveland (CHI), who caught 6 of 7 targets for 65 and a TD in Week 6. TE4 rest of season for me.
Cam Skattebo (NYG) played 6 snaps with no touches in Week 6, and J.J. McCarthy starts at HOU. RB36 for me this week, a low-end RB3; sit him. RB23 rest of season.
Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) was benched in the second half vs HOU, and Liam Coen calls him week to week through the bye. WR49 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share in Week 8 before you sell.

Emeka Egbuka (TB) returned to practice Friday after missing two days, but he is still in the concussion protocol with the foot injury too. WR41 for me this week at CAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, and only if he clears. Monitor Tampa Bay's final injury report Friday afternoon.

Cole Kmet (CHI) was carted off in the fourth quarter of Thursday's 30-24 win over NE with a right knee injury that NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports is likely season-ending, and Ben Johnson said it did not look good. He is TE47 rest of season for me. Drop him in any league that does not start two tight ends.
Brock Bowers (LV) moved up to a full practice Thursday with the hamstring and calf. He drew 9 targets vs BUF and is my No. 1 tight end this week vs LAR.
Bryce Young (CAR) practiced in full Thursday with the knee, and he has 11 touchdown passes to 1 interception through five games. QB10 for me this week vs TB.

Seattle put tight end Elijah Arroyo (SEA) on IR Thursday, and he needs shoulder surgery that ends his season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. AJ Barner played 93 percent of the snaps after Arroyo got hurt at DEN and is TE21 for me vs KC, outside my top 12. Drop Arroyo for any add on the list.

Alvin Kamara (NO) was limited Thursday with the back, while CJ Donaldson moved up to a full practice with the shoulder. Kamara is RB25 for me vs PIT, a high-end RB3, with Kendre Miller right behind him at RB26. Monitor New Orleans' Friday injury report.

Dalton Schultz (HOU) moved up to a limited practice Thursday with the quad, and Tank Dell practiced in full ahead of his return vs NYG. Schultz is TE18 for me this week, outside my top 12, with Dell and Marvin Harrison Jr. adding mouths; sit him outside deep leagues.
Travis Kelce (KC) was limited again Thursday with the right ankle, and left tackle Josh Simmons went to IR with a bulging disc. Kelce is TE8 for me at SEA. Monitor Kansas City's Friday injury report.

Tyler Warren (IND) did not practice Thursday with the groin, his second straight missed day, and Keenan Allen drew 11 targets when Warren sat in Week 6. Warren is outside my top 12 this week and TE7 rest of season for me. Monitor Indianapolis' Friday injury report.

David Montgomery (HOU) did not practice Thursday with the groin and is expected to miss Week 7 vs NYG, per Aaron Wilson of the Houston Chronicle, and Houston is on bye in Week 8. RB25 rest of season for me. Monitor Houston's Friday injury report for his designation.
items.watch: Houston's Friday injury report for his designation

items.text: Woody Marks (HOU) played 78 percent of the snaps at JAX and every snap inside the 5, and David Montgomery is expected to miss Week 7. RB16 for me vs NYG this week, an RB2.

Brevyn Spann-Ford started over Jake Ferguson (DAL) in Week 6, per the Fort Worth Star-Telegram, and Ferguson ran a route on about half the dropbacks and caught 2 for 13. TE24 for me at PHI, outside my top 12, and TE17 rest of season; sit him outside deep leagues and watch his routes Monday night.
Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner did not practice Wednesday with the calf and is week to week. Kyler Murray (MIN) comes off the bye vs IND and is QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

Chig Okonkwo (WAS) ran a route on more than 80 percent of the dropbacks at SF and caught all 7 targets for 69, a week after a team-high 6 targets, and Terry McLaurin is out for the season. TE19 rest of season for me. Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Antonio Williams (WAS) ran a route on 73, 76 and 74 percent of the dropbacks in Weeks 4 to 6 and led Washington's receivers in routes at SF, with Terry McLaurin out for the season. WR66 rest of season for me. Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Rachaad White (WAS) played about 70 percent of the snaps at SF with Jacory Croskey-Merritt out, and caught 4 of 5 targets for 30 and a TD. Croskey-Merritt is on IR with the groin for at least four games. RB38 rest of season for me. Stash White through the bye, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

items.why: Barkley being ruled out Saturday or inactive Monday puts Pierce back in the RB2 range.
items.text: Dameon Pierce (PHI) played 61 of 64 snaps vs CAR with Saquon Barkley inactive, and that share goes back to Barkley now. Philadelphia waived Jaydon Blue, put Carson Steele on waived/injured and signed Elijah Mitchell to the practice squad, so Pierce is the only backup. RB33 for me this week, a low-end RB3; sit him and hold him as the handcuff unless Barkley is ruled out.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) did not practice Wednesday with the ankle and is expected to miss Week 7 vs DEN, per the Cardinals' report. Bam Knight (ARI) ran 15 times for 80 with most of the red-zone touches the last time Love sat, and he leads the early downs once Love is ruled out. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor Arizona's Friday injury report for both.

items.watch: his practice window opening, Week 8 or later
items.text: Adam Schefter reports Terrance Ferguson (LAR) is expected to stay on IR past his Week 8 eligibility with the ankle, and his recovery will take some time. TE22 rest of season for me, and no FAAB yet; Tyler Higbee is TE10 for me this week at LV. Monitor Ferguson's practice window opening, Week 8 or later.

items.why: He returns around Week 11 at the earliest; with no IR spot open, drop him for any add.
items.text: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (WAS) is on IR with the groin and out at least four games, about Weeks 8 to 11 after the bye. RB43 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; with no IR spot open, drop him for any add on the list.
Jauan Jennings (MIN) has 2 catches for 9 yards in four games, and Tom Pelissero does not expect Minnesota to trade him. WR73 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

John Harbaugh named J.J. McCarthy (NYG) the starter at HOU over Jameis Winston. McCarthy threw for 243 yards, a TD and an interception in relief vs NO, most of it after the Giants fell behind 34-10. He is outside my top 12 this week. Monitor his first start at Houston Sunday before you add him in superflex leagues.
items.watch: his first start at Houston Sunday

items.text: Mike Evans (SF) did not practice Wednesday with the Achilles tendinitis and is expected to miss Sunday at ATL, with San Francisco's bye after it, so Week 9 is the earliest return. WR23 rest of season for me. Hold him on your bench; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.
items.why: Week 9 is the earliest return; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.
No practice window opening after the Week 8 bye makes him a drop.
items.text: Saints GM Mickey Loomis said Jordyn Tyson (NO) won't practice this week with the hamstring but is getting closer. New Orleans plays PIT in Paris Sunday and then has its Week 8 bye, so Tyson has at least two more weeks on IR. WR46 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; no practice window after the bye makes him a drop.
